profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based company founded in 1981, according to the profile information held on it. It is a public company and its ticker is SFTBF. Its own site describes it as the official site of SoftBank Group Corp., whose representative director, chairman and chief executive officer is Masayoshi Son. The site says it covers the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The site also states that it presents the company's thinking in the era of the AI revolution, the work of group companies, and the possibilities that AI brings. No specific AI products are listed in the material available, and the site text does not name individual offerings.

The profile record also lists a CIK identifier, 0001065521, and the website group.softbank. No litigation, no MCP servers, and no tracked products are recorded for the company.
